preamble: In Swedish retroflexion, /r/ followed by /d/ fuses with it into a single voiced retroflex stop [ɖ], and the [r] is no longer pronounced separately. This is cluster fusion (sandhi), part of the same pattern that gives [ʈ], [ɳ], [ɭ] and [ʂ] from /r/ + /t, n, l, s/. It is absent in Southern Swedish and other dialects with uvular r.

examples.note: Retroflexion applies to the whole /rd/ cluster; not found in Southern Swedish with uvular r.

sources: Riad, T. (2014). The Phonology of Swedish. Oxford University Press. https://global.oup.com/academic/product/the-phonology-of-swedish-9780199543571
